capacity_selection.meaning: The extraction freezes the shared source Energy reserve in source_pool_before. That snapshot sets maximum capacity; action identity chooses any destination whose minimum is met. There is no capacity upper gate.
capacity_selection.shared_depletion_tradeoff: Position/time families share body Energy. Earlier chart or resource extraction can lower later snapshots; later depletion cannot change an already frozen extracted object.

warp.link_endpoint_policy: The current SDK provides no != or OR constraint, so link construction does not require distinct endpoints. Self-links are valid but useless and grant no additional capability. Implementations must never emulate inequality with unconstrained or free witness data.

selection_semantics.catalog_isolation: v1/v2 use distinct classes; every v2 reveal/use also checks catalog_version = 2.

use_capacity_policy.selection_note: Use counts are fixed selectable capacities, not probability or rarity odds. A higher source snapshot may select any lower-use action.
